answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Each submission hangs on the onyx of a task receipt, and the vertex is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the garden of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
